zh: 输入框之外也被读取的三个取值——渐隐带高度、数字入场参数与用量色调——移到输入框门控之外（features/composer/vars.css）：等待行与面板在输入框重绘关闭时同样拿到这些值。
en: The three sets of values the rest of the page reads — the fade band's height, the digits' entrance and the usage tones — move outside the composer gate (features/composer/vars.css), so the wait row and the panels hold them with the composer restyle off as well.
